allocation.comparative_reasoning: Cognitive reset: if Runtime saw today's Codex with no inherited question, it would still need to know whether its validated instrument survives interventions it did not author, because that is the difference between a fixture artifact and a usable substrate. I considered PIVOT to C-DELTA-REPAIR to attack the starved claim directly, but Runtime's role is substrate, not the scientific repair claim; the write-then-revert probe is the substrate that makes a future C-DELTA-REPAIR test possible and belongs inside this measurement-generalization transaction. Relative to PHYSICS/PRODUCT alternatives, this is the highest-leverage substrate repair and is not duplicated elsewhere.
allocation.question: Does the validated composite intervention oracle (WAL-byte vector hash + SQL logical projection + stable-header response fingerprint), whose prior result was VALIDATED only against interventions the fixture's own controlled endpoint planted, retain arm-constrained discrimination (point sensitivity and specificity >= 0.90 with two-sided 95% Wilson intervals) when the interventions are externally originated and not fixture-authored, and does a write-then-revert probe on the same substrate produce discriminating positive and null outcomes sufficient to license a local delta-repair substrate?
allocation.rationale: Runtime is IDLE with claim_streak 67 and 15 of its last 10-window experiments on C-MEAS-VALID, so the tunnel_flag is a real signal to read carefully. The prior verdict was a bounded VALIDATED result whose scope is exactly the fixture-planted, authorship-separated Chromium-transport case; the directed generalization to externally-originated interventions is the unblocking step the audit calls for ('finish the Runtime generalization gate'), and the write-then-revert probe builds the substrate for the starved C-DELTA-REPAIR claim. This is measurement-indexed opportunity, not ledger metrology: one transaction decides whether the shared observable is trustworthy beyond the fixture, which every downstream claim currently assumes.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER has 422 canonical experiments but the integrated causal chain (observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness -> real external agent action -> lower end-to-end cost) remains unproven end to end. The recurring failure mode is not null science but invalid instruments at the certificate/control layer (three consecutive C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packets, the C-FRESHNESS GATE-C3 predicate, the frontier stationarity-label packet, and the physics M2/M3 control-plane dead end), plus one genuine external blocker: the C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark cannot run without a programmatic model credential. The highest-leverage moves are therefore substrate/treatment-path repair and unblocking the external comparison, not further local estimator refinement. This cycle I: (1) keep Runtime on the one measurement-generalization transaction whose prior result was VALIDATED at a bounded, fixture-planted scope and whose generalization is the shared prerequisite for delta-repair; (2) pivot Product off the credential-blocked benchmark and onto shipped-kernel treatment-arm liveness on a credential-free substrate, which the audit lists as prerequisite #2 for both headline claims; (3) redirect Intel off internal metrology (whose C-PRODUCT-ECON negative was a reportability result, not SPIDER economics) onto sourcing an accessible model endpoint plus external comparator baselines that directly unblock the benchmark; (4) keep Graph on the freshness certificate repair, the audit-sanctioned freshness prerequisite, rather than a fourth threshold-refinement pass on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE; (5) keep Frontier on its frozen cost-scaling transaction and direct its post-freeze target to the hop-depth re-acquisition cost law, which is materially orthogonal to the mined stationarity-label family; and (6) PARK Physics, whose active pre-freeze design duplicates the observable class of an 84-experiment, tunnel-flagged thread with no new observable or external substrate introduced by the degraded Scout. Frozen transactions (frontier) are preserved and will be resumed by the workflow; only pre-freeze and idle threads are redirected.
